title: Anomaly
description: A detected anomaly in a time series or multivariate data stream, including the affected metric, timestamp, severity score, and contextual metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for the detected anomaly.

metric_name.description: Name of the metric or signal in which the anomaly was detected.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the anomaly was detected.

value.description: The observed metric value at the time of the anomaly.

expected_value.description: The expected metric value based on historical patterns.

anomaly_score.description: Normalized anomaly severity score between 0 (normal) and 1 (highly anomalous).

severity.description: Categorical severity level of the anomaly.

direction.description: Whether the anomaly is a spike above expected, a dip below, or bidirectional.

algorithm.description: The detection algorithm that identified this anomaly.

status.description: Current status of the anomaly alert.

series_id.description: Identifier of the time series or data stream this anomaly belongs to.

dimensions.description: Key-value pairs providing additional context dimensions for the anomaly (e.g., region, service, host).

related_anomalies.description: List of related anomaly IDs grouped in the same root cause cluster.
